newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Gazprom to take up $160mln from Hungarian banks.
newsitem.headline: Gazprom to take up $160mln from Hungarian banks.

text.p: Russia's Gazprom group signed an agreement with three Hungarian banks as lead managers for a syndicated loan of $160 million, the Hungarian news agency MTI said on Wednesday.
MTI said the agreement, signed on Tuesday, covered a loan with a six-month maturity.

MTI said lead managers Altalanos Ertekforgalmi Bank (AEB), Magyar Kulkereskedelmi Bank and OTP Bank would provide half the funds themselves and would syndicate the remaininder through Hungarian banks.
MTI said the loan was the first arranged by Gazprom with Central East European banks.
A Gazprom subsidiary, Gazprombank became the sole owner of AEB earlier this year.
Gazprombank said earlier that AEB would finance part of Russia's gas imports to Hungary and the neighbouring countries and Gazprom's investments in the region.
